title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 8B: The body and appearance
subtitle: Parts of the body, hair and appearance, and getting fit

words.def: the part of the body above your neck, with your eyes, nose and mouth
words.sent: He wears a hat on his ___ when it is cold.

words.def: the part of the body behind you, from your neck to your legs
words.sent: I sit all day at work, so my ___ hurts.

words.def: the part of the body between your head and your shoulders
words.sent: She wears a long scarf round her ___.

words.def: the part of the body where your food goes after you eat

words.def: the part of the body from your shoulder to your hand
words.sent: He fell off his bike and hurt his ___.

words.def: the part of the body at the end of your arm, with five fingers
words.sent: Wash your ___ before you eat.

words.def: one of the five long parts at the end of your hand
words.sent: She wears a gold ring on her ___.

words.def: the long part of the body that you walk and run on
words.sent: After the long walk, my ___s were very tired.

words.def: the part of the body at the end of your leg that you stand on
words.sent: My left ___ hurts when I walk in these new shoes.

words.def: one of the five small parts at the end of your foot

words.def: with no curls or bends

words.def: a light yellow colour, for hair

words.def: not fat; with little flesh on the body

words.def: nice to look at (usually for a girl or a woman)

words.def: interesting and nice to look at

words.def: with a nice face; nice to look at

words.def: a part of the body under the skin that makes you move
